subject.title: Productividad: separar los tipos de operación de Picking y Packing en subtipos

question: Should Picking/Packing subtypes be implemented as derived visuals only, persisted `metadata.operationSubtype`, or new `operationType` enum values with migration/backfill implications?
rationale: The code can infer some subtype signals, but the latest human comment asks for options that avoid schema work, so implementation would otherwise lock in a product and data-model choice before it is confirmed.

options.title: Persist subtype metadata
options.body: Keep `operationType` as `PICKING`/`PACKING`, store `metadata.operationSubtype`, and add derived fallback for historical rows when source metadata is available.

options.title: Visual-only derivation
options.body: Compute subtype groupings in the productivity API/dashboard without persisting a new field, accepting weaker filtering and historical accuracy.

options.title: New operation types
options.body: Add enum values such as `PACKING_MULTIPLE` and `PICKING_SKYPOD`, then explicitly handle compatibility and historical migration/backfill.

recommendation.title: Persist subtype metadata
recommendation.body: Keep `operationType` as `PICKING`/`PACKING`, store `metadata.operationSubtype`, and add derived fallback for historical rows when source metadata is available.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current productivity model and the latest Auto-Packing productivity extension, and is also the operational requester asking to choose among implementation options.
